intro: Dandi Concerned Citizen Initiatives (CCI) is a non-profit organization dedicated to improving the lives of underserved communities. We focus on education, healthcare, social support, peace advocacy, and community development. We also promote security awareness through sensitization programs and collaboration with local security groups and agencies. Our goal is to help maintain peace, reduce conflict, and build safer communities.
mission: To provide support, opportunities, and essential resources to vulnerable people while promoting peace, security, and sustainable development.
vision: A peaceful and empowered society where everyone has access to basic needs, education, safety, and opportunities to thrive.
sallahText: During the Sallah celebration, our team visited a correctional facility to provide support, essential items, and encouragement to inmates. We believe in compassion, dignity, and second chances. This outreach reflects our commitment to spreading hope and humanity.
